result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 source pins StreamableHttpService as a Tower Service<http::Request<_>> and the released official server example mounts that service with axum::Router::nest_service. Within the bounded inspected surface no dedicated rmcp authentication middleware abstraction was found. The minimal source-qualified composition boundary is therefore application-owned HTTP middleware outside rmcp: authenticate before forwarding, insert a server-authenticated Principal into inbound Request extensions, fail closed without invoking rmcp on auth failure, then read Principal through the HTTP Parts propagated into RequestContext. Client _meta is not identity authority.
